posts.title: Eleven consecutive wins
posts.description: Cubs beat the Diamondbacks for their 11th consecutive win this season. The crowd is in on every opportunity to cheer for their home team or distract the contenders. Take me out to the ball game. More than 34,000 attendees showed up to throw the Diamondbacks off their game. 50/50 odds that the crowd was standing or sitting.

posts.title: Give cassettes a try
posts.description: The first eBay haul: 30 well-curated cassettes, a Walkman WM-FX277, and a Maxell MXCP-P100. My partner and I have been trying on different ways to cut back on digital consumption. We got our kid an AM/FM radio last September, and it quickly became her favorite gadget of all time.
